properties.so_saved_final_prompt:
80scomprint, A scan of a vintage ad from the 1980s, frame from an old bootleg VHS ad infused with eerie analog warmth, purple color bleeding into the cursive red text overlay, rolling scan lines and soft degraded grain, building an intimate and seductively melancholic mood, A vertical photorealistic editorial poster composition with a deliberate layered graphic design. The final image is composed in three clear layers: a cosmic neon background in the back, a pair of feminine legs in the middle layer, and large fluorescent typography in the frontmost top layer. The typography must remain fully visible, unobstructed, and never hidden behind the legs or visual effects.

Only a pair of feminine legs and feet is visible, with the rest of the body completely offscreen beyond the upper-right edge. The pose closely follows a playful diagonal floating composition: the legs enter from the upper-right side of the frame and angle diagonally downward toward the lower-center area. Both knees are bent, with one knee higher and closer to the upper-right corner and the other leg slightly behind it. The lower portions of the legs descend through the center-right of the frame, and the feet angle downward with a soft pointed graceful pose. One foot extends lower toward the bottom-center-right, while the other remains slightly higher and tucked back. The silhouette should feel dynamic, weightless, and gently curled, preserving the original playful diagonal angle rather than a straight vertical hanging pose.

The legs wear white ribbed crew socks decorated with repeating red rose blossoms and small green leaves. The socks are clean, cute, and visually prominent, with realistic knit texture and a naturally fitted appearance around the ankles and feet. Subtle floral leg tattoos add personality and visual detail.

Soft neutral studio lighting keeps the legs and socks sharply defined, while hot pink and electric cyan rim lighting traces their contours. The skin appears glossy and dimensional with realistic texture and gentle specular highlights.

The background is deep black and midnight blue with a dreamy cinematic 1980s synth-record atmosphere. Irregular pools of hot pink, cyan, cobalt, violet, orange, and yellow glow around the outer borders. Long smeared rainbow refractions sweep through the upper-left and lower-right corners. Tiny stars, drifting particles, defocused colored light orbs, occasional starburst flares, fluorescent dye-like light bleed, subtle analog grain, gentle chromatic misregistration, and soft halation create layered cosmic depth.

A calmer darker pocket of space is preserved behind the main typography for readability, while the brightest rainbow effects remain concentrated near the edges.

Large fluorescent hot-pink typography is placed as the frontmost top layer of the poster, floating over the finished image as a clean graphic overlay. The text must always appear in front of the legs and remain fully readable even where the composition overlaps visually.

The typography reads exactly:

"sick
ollie
creator
kit
studio"

Each word appears on its own line. The text is stacked vertically and arranged as a bold editorial design element along the left side and lower-left area of the frame, large and highly legible, in a bold retro display serif with broad sculptural curves and elegant curled terminals. The lettering is saturated fluorescent pink with subtle glow and crisp edges. All five words are correctly spelled, fully contained inside the frame, evenly spaced, and completely visible.

The legs may extend visually across the right side and slightly into the center of the composition, but the typography remains the topmost layer and is never blocked. The overall effect is a polished photorealistic fashion poster with dreamy synthwave energy, glossy neon lighting, cosmic depth, and bold foreground typography, while preserving the original diagonal pose and angle of the legs.
